At Insane level, the board edges wrap around; cells on the right edge connect to those on the left edge, and vice versa. Similarly for the top and bottom edges. But in addition, in cells with 3 or 4 connections, the wiring is invisible. Good luck!

At Abyss level, the board is endless: it covers 40 by 40 cells and its edges wrap around, so panning never reveals any end of the board. In addition, in cells with 3 or 4 connections, the wiring is invisible. Good luck!

At Void level, the board is endless: it covers 40 by 40 cells and its edges wrap around. In cells with 3 or 4 connections, the wiring is invisible. And in addition, a fog hides the cells away from the network connected to the server: only the surroundings of the connected cells stay visible. Good luck!

Touch to return to the game
Tap a tile to rotate it a quarter turn. Connect the network from the server to the terminal.
Keep going: every tile connected to the server lights up.
Well done, network solved! Every game is won this way: rotate, connect, light up.
Method: start from the server and follow the connected cables, from neighbour to neighbour. Rotate a tile to begin.
Long-press a well oriented tile: the lock protects it from an unlucky turn.
Carry on from neighbour to neighbour until victory, locking what you are sure of.
Locking is your ally on big boards: keep the method.
The informative hint points at a tile to fix (green frame). Tap Hint.
The corrective hint sets the tile upright and seals it (final lock). Tap Hint.
Solve plays the game for you, one move at a time; a game solved this way never counts toward records. Tap Solve.
Helpers are there to unblock, not to play: your call.
Master board: the edges wrap around. The board is a TORUS: right joins left, top joins bottom.
Solve it: at least one cable crosses the edge of the board to connect beyond.
The torus is everywhere from Master on: think of the board without edges.
Insane level: some tiles are INVISIBLE. Deduce their orientation from their neighbours, then rotate a visible tile.
Keep going: each neighbour constrains the hidden tiles, only victory reveals everything.
The corrective hint reveals a masked tile: a move shown, never played.
Endless board: a 40 x 40 torus, framed on the server. Scroll the window a full turn horizontally, until you FIND the server again.
The board repeats forever: no grey ring. Now travel vertically, one full turn.
Pinch to zoom in and out: the window is your camera, the world stays the same.
The Endless mode is played with the camera: the board has no edges, only windows.
Void level: FOG hides the board. Every connection pushes the mist back. Rotate a visible tile.
Keep going: each won connection lights the area around it.
Fog is won tile by tile: the light follows the network.
